```{r load-db1b, include=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(here)
library(fs)
library(dbplyr)

source(here("R", "01_ingest.R"))
source(here("R", "02_prepare.R"))

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())

# Lecture de la table de données des marchés DB1B
dbExecute(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW db1b_mkt AS
     SELECT *
     FROM read_parquet('%s', hive_partitioning = true)",
    here("data/interim/MARKET/DB1B/**/*.parquet")
  )
)

# Lecture de la table de données des marchés DB1C
dbExecute(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW db1c_mkt AS
     SELECT *
     FROM read_parquet('%s', hive_partitioning = true)",
    here("data/interim/MARKET/DB1C/**/*.parquet")
  )
)

db1b_mkt <- tbl(con, "db1b_mkt")
db1c_mkt <- tbl(con, "db1c_mkt")

# Création du vecteur nommé des différentes tables de référence
lookups <- load_lookups(
  here("data/external/refs/") |> dir_ls(glob = "*ref_*.csv")
)
```

# Principaux marchés origine-destination et transporteurs
```{r compute-table-1}
library(data.table)

carrier_stats <- db1c_mkt |>
  filter(
    RpYear == 2025,
    RpMonth %in% c(10, 11, 12),
    MktGeoType == "2",
    V_Yield == 0,
    MktAmount >= 50,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  recode_cols(
    c("OriginCityMarketID", "DestCityMarketID"),
    list(lookups$city_market_id, lookups$city_market_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    city1 = pmin(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    city2 = pmax(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    MktDistanceGroup50 = as.integer(pmin(
      ceiling(pmax(NonStopMiles, 1) / 50),
      49
    ))
  ) |>
  group_by(MktDistanceGroup50, city1, city2, MktCarrier) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = n() * 2.5,
    mkt_fare = mean(MktAmount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(MktDistanceGroup50, city1, city2) |>
  mutate(
    mkt_passengers = sum(passengers, na.rm = TRUE),
    ms = 100 * passengers / mkt_passengers
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Sélectionne le transporteur ayant le plus grand nombre de passagers pour
# chaque marché origine-destination
largest_carrier <- carrier_stats |>
  group_by(MktDistanceGroup50, city1, city2) |>
  slice_max(passengers, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    MktDistanceGroup50,
    city1,
    city2,
    carrier_lg = MktCarrier,
    large_ms = ms,
    fare_lg = mkt_fare,
    .keep = "none"
  )

# Sélectionne le transporteur proposant le prix moyen le plus faible parmi
# ceux détenant au moins 10 % de part de marché
lowest_carrier <- carrier_stats |>
  group_by(MktDistanceGroup50, city1, city2) |>
  filter(if_else(any(ms >= 10), ms >= 10, TRUE)) |>
  slice_min(mkt_fare, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    MktDistanceGroup50,
    city1,
    city2,
    carrier_low = MktCarrier,
    lf_ms = ms,
    fare_low = mkt_fare,
    .keep = "none"
  )

# Agrège les données par marché origine-destination et sélectionne les 1 000
# marchés ayant le plus grand nombre de passagers par jour
table1 <- db1c_mkt |>
  filter(
    RpYear == 2025,
    RpMonth %in% c(10, 11, 12),
    MktGeoType == "2",
    V_Yield == 0,
    MktAmount >= 25,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  recode_cols(
    c("OriginCityMarketID", "DestCityMarketID"),
    list(lookups$city_market_id, lookups$city_market_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    city1 = pmin(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    city2 = pmax(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    MktDistanceGroup50 = as.integer(pmin(
      ceiling(pmax(NonStopMiles, 1) / 50),
      49
    ))
  ) |>
  group_by(MktDistanceGroup50, city1, city2) |>
  summarise(
    nsmiles = max(NonStopMiles, na.rm = TRUE),
    passengers = n() * 2.5 / 92,
    fare = mean(MktAmount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(passengers, n = 1000, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  left_join(largest_carrier, by = c("MktDistanceGroup50", "city1", "city2")) |>
  left_join(lowest_carrier, by = c("MktDistanceGroup50", "city1", "city2")) |>
  arrange(MktDistanceGroup50, desc(fare)) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    MktDistanceGroup50 = factor(
      MktDistanceGroup50,
      levels = 1:49,
      labels = lookups$distance_groups_50$Description,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  as.data.table()
```


# Principaux marchés origine-destination agrégés par ville
```{r compute-table-2}
# Agrège les données du quatrième trimestre 2025 par marché origine-destination
# et sélectionne les 1 000 marchés ayant le plus grand nombre de passagers
cur_table2 <- db1c_mkt |>
  filter(
    RpYear == 2025,
    RpMonth %in% c(10, 11, 12),
    V_Yield == 0,
    MktAmount >= 50,
    MktGeoType == 2,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  recode_cols(
    c("OriginCityMarketID", "DestCityMarketID"),
    list(lookups$city_market_id, lookups$city_market_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    city1 = pmin(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    city2 = pmax(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID)
  ) |>
  group_by(city1, city2) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = n() * 2.5,
    fare = mean(MktAmount, na.rm = TRUE),
    distance = mean(MilesTraveled, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(
    passengers,
    n = 1000,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    market = paste(city1, city2, sep = "-")
  ) |>
  select(
    market,
    city1,
    city2,
    passengers,
    fare,
    distance
  ) |>
  collect()

# Associe les statistiques de chaque marché aux deux villes qui le composent
cur_city <- bind_rows(
  cur_table2 |>
    mutate(
      city = city1,
      market,
      passengers,
      fare,
      distance,
      .keep = "none"
    ),

  cur_table2 |>
    mutate(
      city = city2,
      market,
      passengers,
      fare,
      distance,
      .keep = "none"
    )
)

# Agrège les données du quatrième trimestre 2024 pour les 1 000 marchés
# sélectionnés en 2025
ly_table2 <- db1b_mkt |>
  filter(
    Year == 2024,
    Quarter == 4,
    MktFare >= 50,
    MktGeoType == 2,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  recode_cols(
    c("OriginCityMarketID", "DestCityMarketID"),
    list(lookups$city_market_id, lookups$city_market_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    city1 = pmin(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    city2 = pmax(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID)
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    cur_table2 |> select(city1, city2),
    by = c("city1", "city2"),
    copy = "inline"
  ) |>
  group_by(city1, city2) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers) * 10,
    fare = sum(MktFare * Passengers) / sum(Passengers),
    distance = sum(MktMilesFlown * Passengers) / sum(Passengers),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  select(
    city1,
    city2,
    passengers,
    fare,
    distance
  ) |>
  collect()

# Associe les statistiques de chaque marché aux deux villes qui le composent
ly_city <- bind_rows(
  ly_table2 |>
    mutate(
      city = city1,
      passengers,
      fare,
      distance,
      .keep = "none"
    ),

  ly_table2 |>
    mutate(
      city = city2,
      passengers,
      fare,
      distance,
      .keep = "none"
    )
)

# Agrège les statistiques du quatrième trimestre 2024 par ville
ly_table2 <- ly_city |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarise(
    ly_passengers = sum(passengers),
    ly_fare = mean(fare),
    ly_distance = mean(distance),
    ly_yield = ly_fare / ly_distance * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Agrège les statistiques du quatrième trimestre 2025 par ville et conserve
# celles comptabilisant plus de 100 000 passagers
table2 <- cur_city |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarise(
    markets = n_distinct(market),
    cur_passengers = sum(passengers),
    cur_fare = mean(fare),
    distance = mean(distance),
    cur_yield = cur_fare / distance * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(cur_passengers > 100000) |>
  left_join(ly_table2, by = c("city")) |>
  arrange(distance) |>
  as.data.table()
```

# Marchés origine-destination présentant les plus fortes hausses tarifaires
```{r compute-table-3}
# Agrège les données du quatrième trimestre 2025 par marché origine-destination
# et sélectionne les 1 000 marchés ayant le plus grand nombre de passagers
cur_city_stats <- db1c_mkt |>
  filter(
    RpYear == 2025,
    RpMonth %in% c(10, 11, 12),
    V_Yield == 0,
    MktAmount >= 50,
    MktGeoType == 2,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  recode_cols(
    c("OriginCityMarketID", "DestCityMarketID"),
    list(lookups$city_market_id, lookups$city_market_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    city1 = pmin(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    city2 = pmax(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID)
  ) |>
  group_by(city1, city2) |>
  summarise(
    cur_passengers = n() * 2.5,
    cur_fare = mean(MktAmount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  select(
    city1,
    city2,
    cur_fare,
    cur_passengers
  ) |>
  slice_max(cur_passengers, n = 1000, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

# Agrège les données du quatrième trimestre 2024 par marché origine-destination
ly_city_stats <- db1b_mkt |>
  filter(
    Year == 2024,
    Quarter == 4,
    MktFare >= 50,
    MktGeoType == 2,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  recode_cols(
    c("OriginCityMarketID", "DestCityMarketID"),
    list(lookups$city_market_id, lookups$city_market_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    city1 = pmin(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID),
    city2 = pmax(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID)
  ) |>
  group_by(city1, city2) |>
  summarise(
    ly_passengers = sum(Passengers) * 10,
    ly_fare = sum(MktFare * Passengers) / sum(Passengers),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  select(
    city1,
    city2,
    ly_fare,
    ly_passengers
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Joint les statistiques de 2025 et 2024 et calcule les variations du prix
# moyen et du nombre de passagers
city_pct <- cur_city_stats |>
  left_join(ly_city_stats, by = c("city1", "city2")) |>
  mutate(
    amount_change = cur_fare - ly_fare,
    percent_change = 100 * amount_change / ly_fare,

    amount_change_pax = cur_passengers - ly_passengers,
    percent_change_pax = 100 * amount_change_pax / ly_passengers
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(ly_fare),
    !is.na(ly_passengers),
  )

# Sélectionne les marchés dont le prix moyen a augmenté d'au moins 15 %
table3 <- city_pct |>
  filter(percent_change >= 15) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_change)) |>
  collect() |>
  as.data.table()

table3
```

## Tracé diagnostique
```{r plot-table-3-diagnostic}
library(ggplot2)

dt1 <- city_pct |>
  arrange(percent_change) |>
  mutate(
    cum_passengers = cumsum(cur_passengers),
    total_passengers = sum(cur_passengers),
    weighted_ecdf = cum_passengers / total_passengers
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  as.data.table()

# Calcule la fonction de répartition empirique des variations tarifaires
# pondérée uniformément par marché
dt2 <- city_pct |>
  arrange(percent_change) |>
  mutate(
    ecdf = row_number() / n()
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  as.data.table()

# Compare les deux fonctions de répartition empirique des variations tarifaires
ggplot() +
  geom_step(
    data = dt1,
    aes(x = percent_change, y = weighted_ecdf, color = "Passenger-weighted")
  ) +
  geom_step(
    data = dt2,
    aes(x = percent_change, y = ecdf, color = "Market-weighted")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-25, 25, 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Empirical Quantile Function of Fare Changes",
    subtitle = "Fourth Quarter 2025 vs. Fourth Quarter 2024",
    x = "Year-over-Year Fare Change (%)",
    y = "Quantile"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Weighting")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```

```{r render-table-3, echo=FALSE}
    columns = percent_change_pax,
    fns = list(TOTAL = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE)),
    ~ fmt_percent(., decimals = 1, scale_values = FALSE, sep_mark = ".")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", align = "right"),
    locations = cells_grand_summary(columns = everything())
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table_body.hlines.color = "transparent",
    stub.border.color = "transparent"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = c("left"),
      weight = px(2),
      color = "#BFBFBF"
    ),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = c(cur_fare, cur_passengers)),
      cells_column_labels(columns = c(cur_fare, cur_passengers))
    )
  )

table3_gt |> gtsave("tab3.html", path = "outputs/tables/")

table3_gt
```

# Marchés origine-destination présentant les plus fortes baisses tarifaires
```{r compute-table-4}
# Sélectionne les marchés dont le prix moyen a diminué d'au moins 11 %
table4 <- city_pct |>
  filter(percent_change <= -11) |>
  arrange(percent_change) |>
  collect() |>
  as.data.table()

table4
```

```{r render-table-4, echo=FALSE}
# Met en forme et exporte le tableau 4
table4_gt <- table4 |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "City-Pair Markets with the Largest Percentage Decrease in Average Fare 11% or Greater Decrease",
    subtitle = "Fourth Quarter 2025 vs. Fourth Quarter 2024"
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Table 4", columns = c(city1, city2)) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Average Each Way Fare",
    columns = c(cur_fare, ly_fare, amount_change, percent_change)
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Passengers",
    columns = c(
      cur_passengers,
      ly_passengers,
      amount_change_pax,
      percent_change_pax
    )
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    city1 = "City-Pair",
    city2 = "",
    cur_fare = "2025 q4",
    ly_fare = "2024 q4",
    amount_change = "Amount<br>Change",
    percent_change = "Percent<br>Change",
    cur_passengers = "2025 q4",
    ly_passengers = "2024 q4",
    amount_change_pax = "Amount<br>Change",
    percent_change_pax = "Percent<br>Change",
    .fn = md
  ) |>
  fmt_currency(
    columns = c(cur_fare, ly_fare, amount_change),
    currency = "USD",
    decimals = 0
  ) |>
  fmt_percent(
    columns = c(percent_change, percent_change_pax),
    scale_values = FALSE,
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(cur_passengers, ly_passengers, amount_change_pax),
    decimals = 1,
    sep_mark = ","
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(city1, city2)) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(cur_fare, ly_fare, cur_passengers, ly_passengers)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(
      amount_change,
      percent_change,
      amount_change_pax,
      percent_change_pax
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", align = "center"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", align = "left"),
    locations = list(
      cells_column_spanners(),
      cells_column_labels()
    )
  ) |>
  grand_summary_rows(
    columns = c(
      cur_passengers,
      ly_passengers,
      amount_change_pax
    ),
    fns = list(TOTAL = ~ sum(., na.rm = TRUE)),
    ~ fmt_number(., decimals = 0, sep_mark = ",")
  ) |>
  grand_summary_rows(
    columns = percent_change_pax,
    fns = list(TOTAL = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE)),
    ~ fmt_percent(., decimals = 1, scale_values = FALSE, sep_mark = ".")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", align = "right"),
    locations = cells_grand_summary(columns = everything())
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table_body.hlines.color = "transparent",
    stub.border.color = "transparent"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = c("left"),
      weight = px(2),
      color = "#BFBFBF"
    ),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = c(cur_fare, cur_passengers)),
      cells_column_labels(columns = c(cur_fare, cur_passengers))
    )
  )

table4_gt |> gtsave("tab4.html", path = "outputs/tables/")
```
